name: ffuf
title: ffuf
description: HTTP fuzzer — substitutes the literal token 'FUZZ' in the URL with each line of a wordlist. Set FFUF_TARGET (e.g. https://target.example.com/FUZZ) and FFUF_WORDLIST to an absolute path inside the container. The agent image ships no wordlist; place one in the container before launching the scan. FFUF_MATCH_CODES is a list of HTTP status codes to consider hits (e.g. 200, 204, 301, 302, 401, 403); FFUF_FILTER_SIZE filters out responses of a given size (e.g. soft-404 length); FFUF_EXTENSIONS is a list of suffixes to append to each word (e.g. .php, .bak, .zip). FFUF_SEVERITY labels findings — valid values: info | low | medium | high.
